summary.goal:
Extend this tiny todo library. Add to src/todo.js:
- toggle(id): flips the item's done flag and returns the item; throws an Error whose message contains "Unknown id" for an unknown id.
- remove(id): deletes the item and returns true, or returns false when the id is unknown.
- count(): returns the number of items.
Keep add(text) and list() working as they are (list returns a copy). Add tests for the new methods in test/ using node:test, and write a README.md that documents createStore, add, list, toggle, remove and count with a short example. npm test must stay green.

tasks.title: Add toggle(id), remove(id) and count() to src/todo.js
tasks.spec:
Edit src/todo.js only. Keep createStore() as the single export, keep the `items` closure array, and keep add/list exactly as they are (add still assigns `id: items.length + 1` and returns the new item; list still returns `items.slice()`). Add three methods to the same returned object literal:

- `toggle(id)`: locate the item with `item.id === id` (strict equality). Flip its `done` flag and return that same item object (live reference). If no item matches, `throw new Error("Unknown id: " + id)` — the message must contain the exact substring `Unknown id`. Do not auto-create items and do not return a copy.
- `remove(id)`: locate the item with `item.id === id`, splice it out of `items`, return `true`. If no item matches, return `false` and change nothing. Never throw, including for a non-numeric or missing id.
- `count()`: return `items.length`.

Style: ESM, no imports, no new dependencies, no changes to package.json, no exported helpers — implement inside the object literal next to add/list. Do not reformat or restructure add/list and do not alter list()'s copy semantics.

Verification: `npm test` must still pass the pre-existing `add and list` test, and the smoke command below exercises the new methods end to end (count/toggle identity/toggle round-trip/remove true then false/unknown-id throw).

commands: node -e 'Promise.all([import("./src/todo.js"), import("node:assert/strict")]).then(([{ createStore }, { default: assert }]) => { const s = createStore(); const a = s.add("write docs"); assert.equal(s.count(), 1); assert.equal(s.toggle(a.id), a); assert.equal(a.done, true); assert.equal(s.toggle(a.id), a); assert.equal(a.done, false); assert.equal(s.list().length, 1); assert.equal(s.list()[0].done, false); assert.equal(s.remove(a.id), true); assert.equal(s.remove(a.id), false); assert.equal(s.count(), 0); assert.equal(s.list().length, 0); assert.throws(() => s.toggle(999), /Unknown id/); assert.throws(() => s.toggle(999), Error); }).catch((err) => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });'
acceptance.review: Confirm in src/todo.js that add and list are byte-for-byte unchanged in behaviour (list still returns a fresh array, add still returns the created item), that toggle returns the stored item object rather than a copy, that the thrown message reads `Unknown id: <id>`, and that remove returns booleans instead of throwing. Confirm no new imports, dependencies or files were introduced.

Error message built as 'Unknown id: ' + id so the required substring 'Unknown id' is exact.

tasks.title: Cover toggle, remove and count with node:test
tasks.spec:
Create the new file test/store-methods.test.js (do not edit test/todo.test.js). Follow the existing convention: `import test from 'node:test'`, `import assert from 'node:assert/strict'`, `import { createStore } from '../src/todo.js'`, with one `test(<name>, () => { ... })` call per case. Build a fresh store inside each test (no shared mutable state between cases).

Cover at least:

- count(): fresh store reports 0; two adds report 2; one remove reports 1.
- toggle(): returns the same object as the item from add (identity check), flips `done` false -> true, a second call flips it back to true -> false, and the store's own list reflects the flip (both the item in `list()` and the object returned by add).
- toggle() unknown id: `assert.throws(() => s.toggle(<id never added>), /Unknown id/)` and also assert the thrown value is an `Error` (e.g. a second `assert.throws(..., { name: 'Error' })` or catch-and-check on `err instanceof Error`).
- remove(): returns `true` for an existing id, the item disappears from `list()` and `count()` decrements. Returns `false` for an id that was never added, and that failed call leaves `list()`/`count()` unchanged.
- remove(): returns `false` (does not throw) for an id that was already removed in the same store.
- list() still returns a copy: mutating the array returned by `list()` (e.g. push/pop) does not change `count()` or the contents of a subsequent `list()` call.

Do not assert on ids assigned after a remove (per the design decision that add keeps `id: items.length + 1`); assert on counts and texts in those scenarios.

Verification: run the file directly to see the per-test TAP output, then run the whole suite.

acceptance.review: Confirm the new tests would fail against the pre-change module (i.e. they genuinely exercise toggle/remove/count and the `Unknown id` throw rather than restating existing behaviour), that they use the identity of the object returned by add for the toggle assertions, and that test/todo.test.js and src/todo.js were left untouched by this task. Confirm coverage of the `list()` copy guarantee.

report.summary: Created test/store-methods.test.js with 10 node:test cases covering count, toggle (identity, double flip, list sync), toggle's Unknown id error (regex + Error instance checks), remove (true/removal, false for unknown with no side effects, false for already-removed), and the list() copy guarantee. Follows the existing convention exactly (node:test, node:assert/strict, one test() call per case, a fresh store built inside every test). test/todo.test.js and src/todo.js were not touched.
report.evidence: node --test test/store-methods.test.js => 10 pass / 0 fail, exit 0. npm test => 11 pass / 0 fail (10 new + untouched 'add and list'), exit 0. Negative control: ran the same test file in a /tmp scratch dir against an add/list-only createStore; it failed (TypeError: s.count is not a function, exit 1), confirming the tests genuinely exercise toggle/remove/count. git status --porcelain shows only ?? test/store-methods.test.js from this task (src/todo.js modification predates and belongs to the implement task); git diff --stat shows no change to test/todo.test.js.
decisions: Removed/add-mixed scenarios assert on counts and texts only, never on ids assigned after a remove, per the recorded decision that add keeps id: items.length + 1.

The toggle 'is an Error' requirement is covered twice: an assert.throws(..., { name: 'Error' }) case and a separate catch-and-check err instanceof Error case, the latter using a wrong-typed id ('1') because id matching is strict.

The list() copy test mutates the copy in both directions (push an item, then shift the real item off the copy) so that removal from the copy is observable, rather than a push-then-pop that would net out.

tasks.title: Write README.md documenting the store API
tasks.spec:
Create README.md at the repository root. Do not modify any code or test file.

Content:

- Short intro: tiny in-memory todo store, ES modules, zero dependencies, tested with the built-in `node:test` runner.
- Install/run note: no dependencies to install; run the suite with `npm test`.
- A usage example in a fenced ```js block that is real, runnable code for this repo: `import { createStore } from './src/todo.js';` then add two items, call `list()`, `toggle(id)`, `count()`, `remove(id)`, and show the printed results. Use the actual return values (`list` returns a new array of items, `toggle` returns the updated item, `remove` returns `true`/`false`, `count` returns a number). Keep it short — one example, not a tutorial.
- An API section with an entry for each of `createStore`, `add(text)`, `list()`, `toggle(id)`, `remove(id)` and `count()`, each with parameters, return value and the error behaviour: `toggle` throws an `Error` whose message contains `Unknown id` for an unknown id, `remove` returns `false` for an unknown id, `list` returns a copy of the internal array.
- A one-line note that `add` assigns ids as the current item count plus one, without claiming ids are permanently unique or stable across removals.

Keep the README consistent with the implemented behaviour: check each statement against src/todo.js before writing it. No badges, no CI sections, no invented scripts or commands that do not exist in package.json.

acceptance.review: Read the example code in README.md and confirm it would run verbatim from the repository root (correct relative import path, ESM `import` syntax, only methods that exist) and that the values it claims to print match the real behaviour of src/todo.js — including `toggle` returning the updated item, `remove` returning true/false, `count` returning a number, and `list` returning a copy. Confirm all six API entries (createStore, add, list, toggle, remove, count) are documented, that the `Unknown id` error behaviour is stated, and that the file claims no dependencies, scripts or tooling that the repo does not have.

report.summary: Wrote README.md at the repository root documenting the tiny-todo store API. It has a short intro (in-memory store, plain ES modules, zero dependencies, built-in node:test runner), an install/run note (`npm test`, no dependencies to install), one short runnable ESM example, and an API section with entries for createStore(), add(text), list(), toggle(id), remove(id) and count(), each listing parameters, return value and error behaviour. No code or test files were modified.
report.evidence: Ran the README example's exact code via `node --input-type=module -e ...` from the repo root: output was `[ { id: 1, text: 'write the README', done: false }, { id: 2, text: 'run the tests', done: false } ]`, `2`, `{ id: 1, text: 'write the README', done: true }`, `true`, `false`, `1` — matching the comments in the README verbatim. Acceptance greps all exit 0: createStore, toggle, remove, count, 'Unknown id', 'npm test'. `npm test` passed: 11 tests, 11 pass, 0 fail, both test files reported. `git status --porcelain` shows only README.md added by this task.
decisions: The example imports './src/todo.js' relative to the repository root, uses only methods that exist, and its printed comments were copied from actual Node output rather than written by hand.

Documented that list() returns a new array whose elements are the live item objects, that toggle throws an Error containing 'Unknown id' (also for wrong-typed ids such as '1', since matching is strict), that remove returns true/false and never throws, and that add assigns ids as the current item count plus one.
Deliberately phrased the id note so it does not claim ids are permanently unique or stable across removals, per the recorded design decision.
Included no badges, CI sections, or scripts/commands beyond the existing `npm test` in package.json.
